conditional_capabilities.calendar-projection: required only for transactions whose selected policy enables Calendar projection
conditional_capabilities.email-evidence: required only for email-driven ingestion; manual appointment state remains available without it
conditional_capabilities.notification-delivery: required only for native reminder projection
conditional_capabilities.public-provider-research: best-effort enrichment when selected; cache and owner correction are preferred before repeat research
conditional_capabilities.spoken-notification: requires explicit opt-in plus verified native-client TTS/audio delivery; visual reminder paths remain independent

appointment-reconciliation.summary: Evidence-backed appointment reconciliation with durable provider identity caching, configurable reminders, optional Calendar projection, and optional verified native spoken delivery.

conditional_capabilities.drive-evidence: required only when the selected recipe/evidence policy stores long bodies or files externally
conditional_capabilities.finance-evidence: optional cost evidence and never required for basic planning
conditional_capabilities.shopping-intent: required only for the shopping-procurement projection selected by an accepted meal plan; meal-plan state commits first

meal-planning.summary: Adaptive meal, recipe, leftover and grocery-intent planning using a structured state authority plus optional Drive evidence.
